name: 3M 60921 Organic Vapor/P100 Cartridge Filters
summary: Cartridge/filter components for certain organic vapors and P100 particulates. The documented Canadian offer advertises one pair; approved selection, fit and use limits remain essential.
description: The 60921 combines a gas/vapor cartridge with a P100 particulate filter. Its documented scope covers certain organic vapors and oil or non-oil airborne particles when the complete respirator is properly selected and fitted. On a compatible 6800 full facepiece, use a matching pair in the approved configuration. The documented Canadian listing associates ASIN B07571LR2K with model 60921 and an advertised one pair (two cartridges). This records the advertised pack, not an inspection or authentication of delivered contents.

specs.label: Model / filter class
specs.value: 3M 60921; P100 particulate filter combined with a chemical cartridge. Manufacturer designation, not authentication of the listed unit

specs.label: Protection scope
specs.value: P100 particulate filtration combined with protection against certain organic vapors in an approved respirator assembly.

specs.label: Compatible respirators
specs.value: 3M bayonet 6000-series full facepieces, including 6800 Medium, in configurations covered by the applicable instructions and approval label; mechanical fit alone does not establish hazard suitability

specs.label: Components in use
specs.value: Two matching filters or cartridges on the facepiece; replace as instructed. This is the assembly count, not a verified Amazon package quantity

specs.label: Service and replacement
specs.value: Use before expiration and follow an established cartridge change schedule; leave the contaminated area if damaged, soiled or breathing becomes difficult. No universal service life is promised

specs.label: Air supply / exclusions
specs.value: Supplies no oxygen; not for oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health (IDLH) atmospheres

pros: Combines the documented chemical-cartridge scope and P100 particulate filtration in one component.
Manufacturer installation and replacement instructions are available for the exact model family.
cons: Organic-vapor scope does not make the 60921 a multi-gas cartridge; do not substitute it for a cartridge selected for acid gases or other unlisted hazards.
Requires a compatible facepiece, matching components, fit testing, training and a user seal check; a seal check does not replace a fit test.
The current seller, genuine supply, delivered contents, lot and expiration are not independently verified; check the selected offer and packaging before use.
useCases: Compare cartridge scope against an identified occupational chemical and particulate hazard with a competent respiratory-protection professional.
Plan approved components, inspection, fit and replacement procedures before entering any assessed work area.

safetyNotes: Organic-vapor scope does not make the 60921 a multi-gas cartridge; do not substitute it for a cartridge selected for acid gases or other unlisted hazards.
These air-purifying components supply no oxygen. Do not use in oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health (IDLH) atmospheres.
Use two matching compatible components on the 3M 6800 only as an approved assembly selected for the assessed contaminant and concentration; mechanical compatibility is not hazard suitability.
Correct fit, required fit testing, training and a user seal check are essential. Facial hair or damaged parts can compromise the seal.

No universal protection against radiation, biological agents or chemical weapons is established. Particle filtration does not shield ionizing radiation or eliminate infection risk. This is not a CBRN escape system.
Check genuine supply, labels, package integrity and expiration. Follow the delivered manufacturer instructions, change schedule and applicable respiratory-protection program.
